name: US Critical Metals Corp.
summary: US Critical Metals Corp. focuses on the procurement, exploration, and advancement of natural resource assets. The company holds an exclusive option to gain complete ownership of the Haynes cobalt project, a property spanning approximately 192 hectares located within Idaho's Blackbird Mining District, part of the Idaho Cobalt Belt. Furthermore, it possesses an option for 100% interest in the Clayton Ridge lithium project, which covers an estimated 712.25 hectares in Esmeralda County, Nevada. The firm's principal office is situated in Vancouver, Canada.
